featured_reviews.review_text:

The plan suggested to me was practical and clearly explained according to my IQ level, abilities, and potential. I was guided step by step on what to do and what is realistically possible for my future.
I had several insecurities and doubts, which I discussed openly with Psychologist Abdullah Shaikh. He listened patiently, understood my concerns, and helped me gain clarity and confidence. The counseling sessions played a major role in helping me overcome fear and confusion regarding my career decisions.
I am very satisfied with the support I received and 100% recommend this center to anyone who needs proper career guidance or is planning a career switch.

featured_reviews.name: Shubha Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited her back in 2022, and the experience was extremely unprofessional. She even disclosed details about her previous clients, which was a major red flag. Without properly listening to or understanding my concerns, she simply told me to "stay calm and meditate." If my mind had been that calm, I wouldn't have felt the need to consult her in the first place.

She handed me a few crystals and claimed that just holding them would clear my mind. Honestly, all she did was sweet-talk. I had paid in advance for 10 sessions, but after just two, I decided to discontinue. She only refunded half the amount, and since she never gave me a receipt or any formal documentation, I had no grounds to argue. It was a difficult and frustrating experience, but thankfully, I managed to walk away from it. She has 2 office (basically her house) so I visited dahisar branch.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I went in with my husband for couple counselling and in first fifteen minutes without asking for any history about us and just listening to our on going situation she took my husband’s side and started blaming me the issues we have in our marriage. She is not a counsellor but she is some kind of healer who uses stones and crystals. She handed me some stones and decided that I need 30 to 35 sessions to feel better. She calculated and it rounded up to more than 30k she broke down the amount in 3 instalments plus 1500rs for those stones😅. While talking to her she gave me examples of Sita, draupati, Modi, abdul Kalam and herself, telling me how they were good people hence they managed their career and life so well etc etc😂 I felt like i was talking to that neighbouring aunty who gives unsolicited advice. She charged 2600rs for this service.
She must be a good lady in her personal life but not at all professional.
All the best to her future endeavours

From our very first meeting, I felt at ease with Dr. Lodhavia. She created a safe and non-judgmental space for me to open up about my struggles and challenges. Her ability to listen attentively and understand my emotions allowed me to confront my issues and work through them constructively.

Through her thoughtful guidance and personalized treatment, Dr. Lodhavia helped me develop coping strategies and practical techniques to manage my depression effectively. Her genuine care and encouragement motivated me to make positive changes in my life, paving the way for a brighter and more fulfilling future.

I cannot thank Dr. Preeti Lodhavia enough for the profound impact she has had on my mental health and overall well-being. Her dedication and expertise make her an outstanding and life-changing professional, and I wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone seeking support and healing on their journey to mental wellness.
